name: manager-tool-orchestration-plan-template
purpose: Template input for planning a manager agent that calls registered specialist agents as bounded tools.

reader_guide.summary: Use this file with plan-agent-orchestration when a central manager should keep control while invoking subagents as tools.
how_to_read: Read goal and context to understand the requested workflow.
Use manager_agent to choose the central coordinator.
Use requested_agents for an explicit roster or required_capabilities for deterministic matching.
Use allowed_tools and blocked_tools to constrain what subagent tools may use.
Run the default command after editing this template or copying it for a real plan.
update_triggers: The orchestration registry pattern names change.
Agent specs move out of agent-platform/configs/agents.
Tool allowlist or blocked-tool policy changes.
Validation commands for agent orchestration change.

reference_links.title: LangChain Multi-agent Documentation
used_for: subagent, router, handoff, and custom workflow pattern comparison

structure_rules.rule: The selected manager_agent owns the route, tool invocation, merge, evaluation, and final answer stages.
structure_rules.reason: Subagents should help with bounded subtasks without silently taking over the workflow.

structure_rules.rule: Every requested subagent must exist under the configured agent spec registry.
structure_rules.reason: A tool-like subagent is only reusable when its input, output, policy, and validation metadata are discoverable.

structure_rules.rule: Use allowed_tools and blocked_tools to make subagent tool access explicit before execution.
structure_rules.reason: Manager/subagent orchestration becomes risky when inherited tools are hidden or unconstrained.

field_guide.meaning: Short statement of the workflow the manager should orchestrate.
Optional project, risk, source, or operating context for routing.
Registered agent that keeps control of the workflow and calls subagents as tools.
Pattern id from agent-orchestration-registry.json, usually supervisor_router for manager-as-tools.
Explicit subagent roster; leave empty to select by required_capabilities.
Capability phrases used to match registered agent specs when requested_agents is empty.
Optional allowlist that filters tools inherited from subagent specs.
Tool names that subagents must not use in this plan.
Additional triggers that require human approval or arbitration before execution proceeds.
Expected durable outputs, reports, configs, docs, or evaluation artifacts.
Extra validation commands to add to the generated plan.
Scope, safety, performance, privacy, or repository constraints for the manager.
Maximum number of subagents the planner may include when auto-selecting by capability.

goal: Plan a manager/subagent orchestration for creating and validating a reusable agent workflow.
context: The manager should keep control, call specialist agents as tools, merge outputs, and run validation before close-out.
human_checkpoint_triggers: subagent requests direct access to private files
constraints: Do not install a runtime framework unless a separate installation audit approves it.
Manager owns final merge and evaluation.
